title: Nvidia Predicts AI-Fueled Surge Will Extend Into 2028
description: Nvidia Corp. gave a bullish sales outlook for fiscal 2028, with Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress saying the company expects to grow revenue by approximately 70% in fiscal 2028. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow and Kunjan Sobhani break down the news. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Kioxia Plans New Chip Facility in Japan to Meet AI Memory Demand
description: Kioxia Holdings Corp. is building a new fabrication facility at its manufacturing site in Japan’s northern prefecture of Iwate, people familiar with the matter said, ratcheting up production capacity to meet sustained AI-related demand for storage.

title: Nvidia Predicts AI-fueled Sales Surge Will Extend Into 2028
description: Nvidia, the chipmaker at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, gave a bullish sales outlook for fiscal 2028, easing concerns that AI spending is poised to lose momentum. Ed Ludlow breaks down the company's Q2 earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
